title: Adventure Comics #486 #487 Lot DC 1981 Dial H for Hero Marv Wolfman Bronze Age
condition_description: Both bright and glossy with light handling wear; #486 back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Lot of 2: Adventure Comics #486 (October 1981) and #487 (November 1981), DC Comics, presenting Dial "H" for Hero - "the comic YOU create," with Chris and Vicki's reader-designed heroes. Written by Marv Wolfman. 60 cent cover price each.

- #486: "Hell on Earth!" Back cover: Tyco Magnum 440 racing cars ad.
- #487: Ross Andru and Dick Giordano cover. Back cover: MPC Turbo Z-28 model car kit ad.

Condition: both bright and glossy with light handling wear; #486 back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
